     bridge network, generated a real join token from the running server
     (b000aab0-6242-4f92-99fa-728c027617c4), and attested the agent over the real TCP connection.
     `spire-server agent list` confirms one real attested agent afterward.
  3. Registered two real workload entries on the live server, each parented to the real attested
     agent's node SPIFFE ID, with SPIFFE IDs spiffe://veriqo.global/node/node-a and
     spiffe://veriqo.global/node/node-b (selector unix:uid:0 -- see "what this surfaced" below for
     why the trust domain is "veriqo.global" specifically).

     NewServerFromSource listener, and drives a real NewClientFromSource SendRequestVote RPC

    PSAT, TPM) -- unchanged from every prior SPIRE round; this is the one item the closure matrix

    production-scale multi-node cluster with real network partitions between rafttcp peers.
